goal: Search for member M1001, open their record, open a new Savings sub-account for them with nickname "Emergency Fund" and an initial deposit of 250, then confirm and complete opening the account.

decision.thought: Starting the flow: need to fill the search input with member ID M1001 and click search.

action.locatorDescription: Search input field for member ID or name
action.riskRationale: Filling a search box has no side effects.

locatorDescription: Search input field for member ID or name

decision.thought: The search input already has "M1001" filled in. Next step is to click the Search button to submit the search.

action.riskRationale: Clicking search is a read-only action that just displays search results.

decision.thought: Search results show member M1001 Alice Nguyen. Next step is to click "View" to open their record.

action.riskRationale: Viewing a member record is a read-only navigation action with no side effects.

checkpoint.description: Member detail page loads showing Alice Nguyen's info

decision.thought: On the member record page for M1001. Need to click "Open Sub-Account" to proceed to the sub-account creation form.

action.riskRationale: Navigating to a form page, no data changes yet.

checkpoint.description: The sub-account creation form should be visible with account type options including Savings

decision.thought: Account type already defaults to Savings. Now fill nickname field with "Emergency Fund".

action.riskRationale: Filling a text field is non-destructive.

decision.thought: Nickname field already filled with "Emergency Fund". Account type is already Savings (default). Now need to fill the Initial deposit field with 250.

action.riskRationale: Filling a form field has no side effect until submitted.

checkpoint.description: Form still visible with Review button after filling deposit

decision.thought: Fields are filled correctly: account type Savings (default), nickname "Emergency Fund", deposit "250". Next step is to click Review to proceed to confirmation step.

action.locatorDescription: Review button to proceed to confirmation step
action.riskRationale: Clicking Review just proceeds to a confirmation/review screen, no irreversible change yet.

checkpoint.description: Confirmation step should appear after clicking Review

locatorDescription: Review button to proceed to confirmation step

decision.thought: All confirmation details match expected values: Member M1001, savings, Emergency Fund, $250.00. Now click Confirm and Open Account to finalize. This is risky/irreversible as stated on page.

action.riskRationale: This action is irreversible and creates a new sub-account record for the member.

checkpoint.description: Success message confirming sub-account was opened

decision.thought: The page shows "Sub-Account Opened" confirming the savings sub-account was successfully created with the deposit. This matches the goal completion. I'll use a stable substring "Sub-Account Opened" as the terminal signature text, not the specific account number or dollar amount.
decision.terminalMessage: Successfully opened a new Savings sub-account for member M1001 with nickname "Emergency Fund" and initial deposit of $250.
